description: Complete Table S4_1 N-glycan relative-abundance block from Global mapping of glycosylation pathways in human-derived cells, comparing wild-type HEK293 with seven glycosylation knockout conditions.
details: All source-numbered features and both experiment columns for all eight conditions are retained. The article methods explicitly call these two biological replicates. Quantitative zeros become NA without renormalization; original numeric measurements remain in raw_matrix. Same-composition source rows are not collapsed. Five conflicting source compositions are supported by the original name and diagram; one unresolved row remains NA. All conflicting registry IDs and quantitative rows are preserved.
